recipe.build:
sed -r '/signingConfigs.release/d ; /signingConfigs \{/,/^    \}/d' -i android/app/build.gradle
export PUB_CACHE=$(pwd)/.pub-cache
.flutter/bin/flutter config --no-analytics
.flutter/bin/flutter pub get
.flutter/bin/flutter build apk -t lib/main_foss.dart --release --split-per-abi
find . -name '*.apk'
mv build/app/outputs/apk/release/app-arm64-v8a-release-unsigned.apk /outputs/unsigned.apk
